Update build_k3s_modules.sh script to enable specific kernel modules

This commit updates the build_k3s_modules.sh script to enable specific kernel modules required for the k3s build process. The script now copies the kernel config, disables all modules, and enables the necessary modules using the enable_module function. It then builds the modules and copies them to the output directory.

Add Dockerfile and build workflow

This commit adds a Dockerfile and a GitHub Actions workflow for building and publishing a Docker image. The Dockerfile installs the Synology toolkit and the build workflow uses Docker Buildx to build and push the image to DockerHub and GitHub Container Registry.
